pending_queue.what: Draft content and queued changes are reviewed by an administrator. Some tools write organizational metadata, research records or local files immediately; inspect each tool contract.

gsc_warehouse.what: Local SQLite archive of retrieved GSC observations. Local retention avoids server pruning, but upstream sampling, API limits and missing dates still constrain coverage.

outcome_engine.what: Compare observed clicks and leads around applied edits with a site comparison. Results are observational; confounding and overlapping interventions can remain.

revert_loop.what: Queue a snapshot-restore of a regressed edit as a normal pending change.

lead_events.what: Daily Elementor Pro form-submission counts per page — the money metric; auto-folded into outcome_report.

attention_system.what: Pages are eye-paths, not section stacks: archetype spec BEFORE composing, predicted-heatmap audit AFTER (flat_hierarchy = generic-page smell).

widget_schema.what: Live Elementor control registry — NEVER guess setting keys (typos are silent no-ops); queue validates with did-you-mean. v0.80: containers/sections/columns included; every Elementor write is validated on EFFECTIVE values (new > stored > default) with inert_setting / global_token_overrides_literal / defaults_in_effect warnings; widget_schema(post_id, widget_id) shows stored vs effective vs applies for one element. An absent key is a DEFAULT, not unset.

operator_kit.what: Site stores design skills + bootstrap bundle; a fresh machine rebuilds the whole environment from the site.

operator_brain.what: The site stores the WHOLE operator brain (every memory file + index, every skill, CLAUDE.md, secrets-stripped .mcp.json template) AND the bridge bin/ files. whoami on every site tells every laptop whether it is behind (operator_brain.status) and whether its bridge matches (operator_brain.bridge.status), and pushes relevant_rules (HARD/STRICT + site-specific memories) into the first call. A second laptop must never again open a chat with missing tools or unknown rules: pull, restart, continue.
operator_brain.tools: operator_brain_status, operator_brain_push, operator_brain_pull; CLI bin/brain-sync.php (status|push|pull|bootstrap across every site in .mcp.json)

builders.what: Native Elementor composition (recipes, containers, service pages, spec builds) + Divi surgical module edits, including removing a leftover module from a Theme Builder layout without opening the builder (v0.70).

audit_family.what: Rendered evidence plus local design, accessibility and SEO heuristics. Use current observations; scores do not establish ranking effects or a need to rewrite.

seo_playbook.what: Current source-linked SEO policy served from the shared agent contract. Industry detection does not override evidence or operator constraints.

clarity_heatmaps.what: Optional recorded behavior can help evaluate layout hypotheses. Predicted-attention scores are not measured visitor attention.

session_gate.what: Queued changes require current identity, target and environment evidence. Read rendered evidence for published pages, full editor content for drafts and capability evidence for settings. Metadata-only tools declare their own side effects.

version_drift.what: whoami warns when this site runs an older plugin than the local build, and (v0.79) when the LOCAL bridge is older than the site — the "functions are missing" case — with the exact pull to run.

commodity_router.what: Low-CTR diagnostic candidates with unknown cause. No automatic content-investment, retirement or AI attribution follows from a threshold.

aeo_tracking.what: Dated low-CTR, crawler-request and appearance observations. Crawls do not prove citations; low CTR and search appearances do not confirm AI Overviews.

rank_math_schema.what: Edit Rank Math Schema Builder rows in place by dot path (offers.price etc). The ONLY path to those capitalised postmeta arrays — draft_update_postmeta lowercases the key and flattens the array. %variable% placeholders survive.

stack_introspection.what: Read installed plugins, captured admin menus and redacted settings. Inspect runtime schemas and registered adapter controls before a feature plan; discovery is explicitly incomplete where no adapter is available.

asset_references.what: Find and swap a media URL WHEREVER it is stored — post_content of any post type, postmeta, options, termmeta — searching every spelling (JSON-escaped, protocol-relative, root-relative, http twin). This is the way into plugins that keep content outside post_content and have no dedicated tool: popup overlays, sliders, theme option backgrounds. Serialized values are unserialized/rewritten/re-serialized so length prefixes stay valid; rows holding non-stdClass objects are refused, not risked. media_audit finds the heavy files worth swapping.

render_health_guard.what: Does the page still WORK after a change? Queue captures a rendered-page baseline (empty-state strings, markup-anchored element counts, shortcode leakage, PHP errors, HTTP status); the post-apply audit re-fetches cache-busted and compares. A builder empty-state appearing or an element population vanishing is flagged CRITICAL on the pending row + activity log + dashboard within ~30s of apply. Reports only; never auto-reverts. Companion lint change: failures are split into introduced-by-this-change vs pre_existing-in-current-body, and pre-existing structural failures no longer hard-block unrelated edits.
render_health_guard.tools: (automatic on queue + apply; see lint introduced/pre_existing in queue responses)

setting_writes.what: Read current plugin capability/schema evidence, preview a typed scalar setting change, then use the existing review flow. Unsupported values or inactive controls remain explicit; a stored value does not verify its visible effect.

bulk_term_tagging.what: Assign ONE taxonomy term to MANY posts in a single approval. Solves the two ways wp-admin gets this wrong: its category filter misses products sitting in deeper sub-terms, and its product search matches DESCRIPTIONS so accessories that merely mention a brand get tagged. Matching is title_contains (SQL LIKE on post_title only), in_term (a term AND all its children), or explicit post_ids. Returns a plan with matched / already-tagged / will-change counts before anything is queued; rollback restores the exact prior terms on every post, including posts that had none. Products are eligible here even though they are off-limits to body edits, because term relationships cannot corrupt product content or pricing.

content_strategy.what: Claude discovers and maintains niche scope from existing sources and notes. New content does not need an existing GSC gap.

content_workflow.what: Prepare a source-backed workflow, execute it with the connected agent, then verify actual result IDs. A saved plan is not proof of created or applied content.

content_research.what: Bounded competitor observations and claim candidates with extraction limits; no factual or global-originality certification.

context.site_notes_excerpt: # Rules ## Current evidence guidance — 2026-09-09 - Claude owns scope discovery, research and draft preparation. Use current service pages and site notes. GSC observations help prioritization but absence of queries does not mean absence of opportunities. Propose useful questions within verified services and reader needs. - Match the main reader task. Useful related explanations can belong on a service page; create a supporting article when it serves a distinct task. Do not split, merge or retire pages solely because terms overlap or clicks are low. - Compare actual sampled competitor pages and primary sources. Search position, global originality and market demand remain unknown unless independently observed. Provide a supported useful contribution such as a practical explanation, checklist or genuinely documented process. Never invent facts, research, local statistics or expert quotes. - Local audit scores and fixed citation, word or snippet quotas are not Google requirements. Support consequential claims with suitable evidence and context. Low CTR alone cannot establish why performance changed. Compare captures and investigate competing explanations. - Preserve the no-cloning rule: create new content from scratch. Preserve physician consent restrictions: no provider bylines, Person/hasCredential/sameAs markup or medically-reviewed claims without confirmed consent. Lori is not a provider at this facility. - There is one physical ER facility; neighborhood pages do not establish additional locations. Verify current capabilities, address, hours and other service claims before using them. - Keep language/category assignments explicit. Translations may faithfully serve the same reader task; they do not need invented extra facts. Verify Polylang pairing after application. - Read the actual draft/pending/applied state. Saved metadata or a prepared workflow does not prove execution or publication. Use verify_content_workflow for workflow-bound drafts. Verify rendered changes after approval. - The current user request governs the task. An older active working_state is historical context unless it matches that request. Promote new lasting constraints to Rules or Decisions; routine Sessions logs are history. - Sync only reviewed site-relevant knowledge. Do not upload unrelated sites' client files or credentials as part of this site's brain. The following retained records preserve site-specific constraints. Where an older SEO recipe conflicts with this current guidance, use current evidence; historical decisions and session notes are not renewed approval. - **Polylang pairing: ALWAYS verify after publish.** The `polylang_translation_of` arg on `draft_create_post` returns success but the actual Polylang pair often doesn't link. Symptoms: WP admin post list shows "+" icons in the EN/ES columns next to the new pair instead of the language flag. Fix: after the ES post is approved/published, run `polylang_link_translations` with the explicit `{en: X, es: Y}` pair. Idempotent on already-linked pairs. Underlying plugin bug — `draft_create_post` likely fires `pll_save_post_translations` before WP commits the draft row, so the term never writes. Plugin TODO: in `class-apply.php` create_draft_post path, move the Polylang pair call to AFTER the publish_draft pending applies (i.e. fire it in apply_publish_draft, not on insert). - **Content must add new insights and data, not just rehash.** Every post we publish has to bring something the reader cannot get from a single Google search. Two-part rule: 1. **Add new insights and data — yes.** Concrete: cite a specific authority (AAP guideline, CDC stat, NIDDK threshold, Texas DSHS volume), then frame what that data means for our catchment (White Rock Lake, Lake Highlands, East Dallas) and what action it triggers at home or in the ER. The data point + the local-action framing IS the insight. 2. **Drop the opinion layer.** We are not the first to write about appendicitis or food poisoning, so a "we believe…" / "we think the best approach is…" framing is hollow. Anchor every claim to a guideline, a peer-reviewed source, or a fact we can show is true (our own imaging turnaround, our transfer relationships, etc.). Editorial color is fine; freestanding opinion is not. **How to apply when drafting:** identify the reader task, necessary baseline explanation and supported useful contribution before writing. Inspect existing coverage. Use appropriate primary sources for consequential claims; do not invent data or operational facts. Translations may faithfully serve the same task and do not require additional facts to satisfy a quota. - **Be terse on pending-change reports.** Report actual draft, pending and applied states after checking the records. Never assume automatic approval or publication from old notes. Give the concrete result and any unresolved issue concisely. - **Local landing pages (Garland / Lake Highlands / Lakewood / etc.) are HUB pages, not satellite locations.** ER of White Rock has ONE physical facility at 10705 Northwest Highway. The neighborhood pages (e.g. `/emergency-room-garland-tx/`, `/emergency-room-lake-highlands-tx/`, `/emergency-room-lakewood-tx/`, and the ES `/es/sala-de-emergencias-cerca-de-*/` equivalents) are SEO hubs designed to pull traffic from those neighborhoods INTO the single White Rock facility. They do NOT have their own street address, phone number, or staff. Never suggest adding a per-neighborhood NAP — there is no separate location. Unique-value framing for these pages must be: drive-time from the neighborhood to 10705 Northwest Hwy, named local landmarks/schools/parks that orient the reader, the comparison vs the nearest hospital ER for that neighborhood, and neighborhood-specific scenarios (Lake Highlands trampoline fall, Lakewood evening jog at the lake, Garland border traffic patterns). NAP stays the canonical 10705 Northwest Hwy / (469) 943-2939 across all hub pages. - ## Content drafting + optimization rules (apply to every new post/page AND every existing-post optimization) 1. **Niche and demand research**: use current services, audience questions, existing coverage and available GSC observations. GSC is optional evidence; absent queries do not mean no opportunity. Never fabricate demand. 2. **Comparable-page research**: inspect actual relevant competitor pages and primary sources. Record URLs, capture dates and coverage; do not call them top-ranking without observed search evidence. Develop a supported useful contribution without copying or claiming global novelty. 3. **User-first alongside keyword/competitor**: the post serves the reader first. Keyword and competitor optimization shape what we cover and how we structure it, but the prose, tone, and depth must answer the user's real question better than any competitor — not stuffed with keywords or built for the algorithm. 4. **Useful contribution**: answer the reader task accurately and add supported practical value where useful. Do not invent facts, local statistics, research, expert quotes or service capabilities. Physician-consent restrictions still apply. An absence in sampled competitor excerpts does not establish uniqueness. **These rules apply universally**: new blog posts, new pages, optimization of existing posts, optimization of existing pages. - ## Paragraph breaks follow MEANING, not sentence counts (REVISES the older "2-3 sentence max" rule) The earlier "2-3 sentences max per paragraph" guidance was a crude band-aid for wall-of-text paste-ins from Google Docs. policy.new_blog_workflow: Use content_workflow for a complete new-blog task, then execute its steps. plan_blog_content initializes an inferred strategy when none is saved. policy.agent_ownership: Claude handles discovery, strategy metadata, research, draft preparation and verification. The operator reviews concrete results and exceptions. Metadata writes do not authorize live content publication.
policy.background_execution: A connected Claude session executes the workflow. This feature does not launch an unattended AI runner.
policy.gsc_role: Observed visibility for this property and period, not total market demand or the boundary of the niche.
policy.no_data_meaning: Demand is unmeasured. It does not mean no opportunity.
decision_rules: Similarity discovers candidates; it does not establish duplication or SEO harm.
Create when a distinct reader task and supported niche relationship justify it; no impression minimum is required.
Keep or link complementary pages. Review preservation before merging substitutable pages.
Diagnose technical, demand and measurement changes before prescribing a rewrite.
Research and formatting cannot certify global novelty, expertise or ranking gains.
Persist evidence and alternatives. Do not change a decision without a changed basis.
policy.result_verification: Link new drafts with workflow_id and call verify_content_workflow. Only actual records and current source observations support completion claims; a plan or generated text alone does not.
policy.setting_workflow: Read get_plugin_settings and inspect_plugin_capability. Valid input types do not certify an active feature or rendered effect; use current runtime controls and verify the outcome.
